_comment: The text of README.txt of a base package (base/export.py), in this language: {name}, {version}, {documents}, {created} are filled in; every pack that has the key adds its own part.
package_readme: 1. Install Assistant X (Setup.bat of its medium), if it is not on this PC yet.
2. Ask Claude: "AX: install the base package <path to this file>", or run
assistant-x base inspect "<path to this file>"
assistant-x base install "<path to this file>" --confirm
Your own documents stay; Claude asks you about duplicates and new versions first.
